 Serve as a business partner to internal and external stakeholders, for data\-analytic deliverables (including R\&D) that are not automated or routine in nature, and require programming and data analysis expertise. Develops data assets for analytic deliverables, including basic data analysis, advanced statistical analyses (e.g. regression\-type models and data mining methods), reporting, and visualization (e.g. reports, dashboards, info\-graphics). Perform analytic work, including executing analyses, producing reports and other analytic deliverables.
   

  

 Duties and Responsibilities
   

  

* Under direction of a technical lead, in collaboration with other business partners serving the analytic client, execute on deliverables requirements.
* Independently produce analysis (e.g. basic data analysis, statistical test, statistical modeling) or analytics (e.g. a dashboard), with appropriate technologies (e.g. Excel, Tableau, R, Python, Tableau, PowerBI)
* Independently write programs in appropriate language (e.g. R, SQL, SPSS, SAS), to develop data (sets) needed to support deliverables.
* Produce written reports, for internal constituents, which summarize analytic deliverable; including methods, interpretations, and business implications
* Support ad\-hoc analytic advisory support to internal clients (e.g. sales, account management, advisory services, product management, and consulting), including answering data and methodology questions, interpretation of results and
* Stay abreast of contemporary analytics, such as big data technologies (e.g. cloud services, Hadoop, OLAP tools), analytic technologies (e.g. R, Python, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.), and statistical (including data\-mining) methods.
* Stay abreast of healthcare industry issues affecting PG clients (e.g. VBP, HCAHPS, “Population Health”).
* Independently, and in collaboration with business partners (e.g. Strategy, Development, Product Management, and CRA) prototype scalable, novel analytic solutions that address important business questions.
* Independently, develop and prototype novel data sets that integrate existing PG or external data, for the purpose of developing novel analytic solutions.
* Ensure accuracy and quality of deliverables
* Exhibit interpersonal skills that foster collaborative working relationships.
* Document work.


**Qualifications Include**
* Bachelors or higher in Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or other quantitative discipline
* 1\-3 years experience in a data\-analytic intensive role
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency with SQL, SAS, R, STATA or other high level data programming language
* Basic to intermediate proficiency with Python, PHP, Perl, VB, JavaScript, C\+\+ or other programming language
* Formal training or extensive applied experience with advanced statistical methods such as regression\-type modeling, data\-mining methods (e.g. classification trees)
* Proficiency with data visualization
* 1\-3 years developing data that merges relational tables, either within a relational database or related “big data” environments (e.g. SQL Server, Hadoop)
* 1\-3 years of real world data and statistical analysis experience
* 1\-3 years project management experience, including demonstrated success with cross\-functional collaboration
* 1\-3 years implementing novel analytics with minimal supervision
